frame_count_is_not_a_stochastic_signal.observation: all four runs produced exactly 48000 samples -- 50 codec frames
frame_count_is_not_a_stochastic_signal.reason: the canvas length is fixed by the deterministic RuleDurationEstimator before the first forward, so sampling changes content but never length
frame_count_is_not_a_stochastic_signal.contrast: qwen3-tts sampled runs differed in length (51840 vs 76800 frames) because its length is an autoregressive stop decision. A test that compares only durations would report this family as deterministic when it is not

seeding.mechanism: Gumbel noise is drawn from the global torch RNG
seeding.consequence: there is no upstream stream to reproduce. The package sets the stochastic capability; any public seeding is this port's own stream, validated by the project's own seed contract (same seed -> byte-identical PCM, different seeds -> artifact_differs). Exact-token goldens run greedy, where no RNG call is made at all

oracle_smoke.byte_identity_evidence: cmp(1) reports the two runs' raw f32 dumps identical; sha256 2710bbd2cffb9f4f7bce3ea3164ffd0908c6e6c496debd3fb9292a8337a6fbb1 for both; max_abs_diff exactly 0.0
oracle_smoke.no_rng_call: with both temperatures at zero the decode loop takes neither Gumbel branch, so the identity is a property of the arithmetic rather than of a seeded generator -- which is why it holds across processes and not merely within one
oracle_smoke.real_time_factor_note: CPU F32 on a 20-core aarch64 host with the GPU unused. Upstream's README claims RTF as low as 0.025 on GPU; the two figures measure different things and neither predicts this project's GGML CPU speed

sampled_control.evidence: cmp(1) reports the two sampled dumps differing at byte 1

residual_output_scaling.finding: peak-normalise-to-0.5 remains active with all three post-processing switches off
residual_output_scaling.measured: the greedy run's peak is exactly 0.5, and the sampled runs' peaks are also exactly 0.5 despite different content
residual_output_scaling.source: OmniVoice._post_process_audio; only the remove_silence call is gated on postprocess_output, and fade_and_pad_audio is a no-op at pad_duration=0 and fade_duration=0, but the volume branch between them is gated on nothing

branches.ref_rms is None: peak = abs(audio).max(); if peak > 1e-6: audio = audio / peak * 0.5
branches.ref_rms is not None and ref_rms >= 0.1: no scaling at all -- the elif chain falls through

residual_output_scaling.when_each_applies: ref_rms is None for auto-voice and voice-design (ref_rms_list = [None] * batch_size when no voice_clone_prompt); in clone mode it is the reference audio's RMS carried on the VoiceClonePrompt
residual_output_scaling.paired_forward_operation: at reference-encode time the package boosts a quiet reference with 'if 0 < ref_rms < 0.1: ref_wav = ref_wav * 0.1 / ref_rms', so the output branch is its exact inverse
residual_output_scaling.gate_asymmetry: the forward gate is 0 < ref_rms < 0.1 while the inverse gate is ref_rms < 0.1. A digitally silent reference (ref_rms == 0.0) is therefore not boosted on input but is multiplied by zero on output. An edge case the port must reproduce or deliberately reject
residual_output_scaling.consequence: this scaling is part of the family's contract, not product polish. Plan 2's port must mirror all three branches, and a port that only reproduced the codec would be quietly wrong by a per-utterance gain factor

audio_delivery_claim.reason: the model paints a whole fixed-length canvas at once, so there is no partial result that would be honest to hand back. Neither Chunked Audio Delivery nor Native Streaming Synthesis is claimed in v1
audio_delivery_claim.long_form: upstream's path beyond the validated ceiling is text chunking with cross-fade stitching (cross_fade_chunks in the decode path), which is upstream-side product behaviour and out of scope for v1
audio_delivery_claim.max_output_frames_meaning: 30 seconds at 25 Hz -- a statement about what this port validates, not about what the model can do

open_decisions: Generator on CUDA. The codec moves first, following the qwen3-tts codec-on-CUDA precedent. Placing the generator on CUDA is claimed only if placement evidence proves the committed token grids bit-identical to CPU. One reference port measured CUDA-F32 token-exact and Metal-F32 at 83%, which is encouraging and not evidence. Stage 7 decides.

Quantized profiles against the argmax cascade. A reference port measured token agreement collapsing from 100% to roughly 7% with F16 generator weights: a flipped argmax is committed, fed back into both CFG branches, and conditions every later step. Whether any profile below F32 survives the exact-token gates is an open measurement. Stage 6 decides, and a failing profile is simply not shipped.
The Gumbel replay seam. Implemented only if a sampled-path parity case proves it necessary; the project's own seed contract covers the public sampled path otherwise.

Residual output scaling. Measured at intake: with postprocess_output=False, pad_duration=0 and fade_duration=0, remove_silence and fade_and_pad are inert but the volume branch is not -- auto-voice and voice-design outputs are peak-normalised to exactly 0.5, and clone outputs with a reference RMS below 0.1 are scaled by ref_rms/0.1. What has NOT been decided is where this lives in the port: inside the family's synthesis path (faithful to the oracle, but a hidden gain the public interface never mentions) or hoisted into a documented, disableable normalisation control. Plan 2 decides, and the golden tolerances depend on the answer because the oracle dumps carry the scaling.

Voice-design instruct passthrough. v1 does not reimplement upstream's _resolve_instruct normalisation. Oracle cases pin already-normalised instruct strings, so the port passes Description Text through unchanged and the normalisation stays an upstream concern until something forces it inward.

The clone reference artifact is pinned by content digest rather than by revision, because upstream ships no audio asset at any revision-addressable location -- not in the source repository at 468e927b, not in the Hugging Face Space, and the authors' demo page has no pinnable revision. Task 5 owns the final manifest choice between the 24 kHz PCM SeedTTS clip (has a transcript, no decoder in the path, unclear licence) and the Common Voice MP3 (CC0, but no transcript and an MP3 decoder in the path).

Whether the codec encoder half ships in the Model Package at all. Plans 1 and 2 need only the decoder side; the HuBERT semantic branch, the acoustic encoder and RVQ encode are Plan 3 work for reference-audio cloning. The split is roughly semantic_model (210) plus acoustic_encoder (110) plus encoder_semantic (13) against acoustic_decoder (110) plus decoder_semantic (14) plus quantizer (64).
